reviews.title: Banned for No Reason — No Proof, No Fairness
reviews.text:
I spent a lot of money and time on this game only to get banned for absolutely no reason. No evidence, no proof, no explanation — just vague copy-paste responses about “security” and “irregular activity.”

It feels like this company only listens to players who spend more money or have more influence. If a high spender reports you after losing to you, suddenly your account gets investigated and banned? That does not feel fair at all.

The game constantly pushes new updates, events, and packages that seem focused on getting more money from players, but when real customer support is needed, they hide behind generic messages about “security” and refuse to provide any transparency.

If you are going to ban paying players, at least provide actual proof and a fair appeal process instead of repeating the same scripted response. Extremely disappointing experience after investing so much time and money.

reviews.title: Fun despite minor nitpicks
reviews.text: Honestly, I'm not sure what's up with everyone having performance issues—maybe they just need to turn down the graphics and stuff. Apart from the occasional lag that ramps up (that is, quite literally fixed by closing and re-opening the game), and the copious amount of p2w (which makes it impossible to overcome whales, which lets be honest—is forever going to be an issue with games like these), it's a good game. There's a lot of depth in how you can build your character between relics, skills, allies and your own gear; and as long as you're willing to commit like an hour or so throughout the day you can easily get good enough. Love it. 9/10.

reviews.title: The game is AWESOME
reviews.text:
I usually rarely play games like this because it’s hard to find one with long term playability, but this one hits all the check boxes. The story is actually engaging and interesting, I genuinely want to see more of it rather than feeling like it’s in the way like in other games. Gaining power is quick and there’s always something to do which is awesome, I don’t feel like I need to purchase ANYTHING to keep going in this game which is amazing. There aren’t a whole bunch of ads which I LOVE, makes me wanna play even more.

Some issues I’ve seen are; the translation is off occasionally which makes it kinda hard to understand, but it’s not really an issue. The main problem with this game is the consistent crashing, today I’ve been playing for an hour and it crashed 3 times. I play on an iPhone 11 if that helps. Working on optimization would make this game ABSOLUTELY top tier, after level 70 it’s been crashing a lot more. Also, the game occasionally has connectivity issues; when my wifi and data connections are fine it’ll fail to connect and throw me a couple different errors. 

The crossover with Lloyd is the only reason I downloaded this and I’m SO glad I did, I love that manhwa and this game so much now. The art is also amazing, 9.9/10 overall, it would be 10000/10 if you guys fixed the crashing. Keep up the great work, I hope to see more manhwa or anime crossovers in the future! If you guys take suggestions, Murim Login or Solo Leveling would probably be perfect for this game, ESPECIALLY Murim Login.

reviews.title: Can’t Watch Ads
reviews.text:
I downloaded the game for the Nano Machine event since I absolutely love it. From the start I was unable to watch any ads for rewards that the game prompted me with. After about a week of playing they still have not fixed the issue even though it is an issue amongst others in the community. There’s a bundle for 12$ to completely remove ads but I refuse to buy it due to being strictly free to play. I’ve submitted tickets for customer support along with notified people on the official discord. I assume they aren’t fixing it because people will just buy the bundle for no ads and will fix it eventually. Even if they do fix it I don’t want to play a game where they don’t fix known issues and compensate their players for the rewards lost. 

Otherwise this is a rather enjoyable game with a good amount of content to play every day.
